'''Marble''' was a rock used in the construction of buildings.

Types of marble included [[Durosian marble]], [[Selonian marble]] and [[Wayland marble]].

Companies that provided marble included [[Ralltiir Consolidated Marble]] and [[XwiziMarble]].<ref name="CatCW" />

The royal [[Fountain Palace]] on [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]] was built with marble hallways.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]''</ref>

Marble mosaic was found in [[Kesh Sith Temple|Sith Temple]] on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]].<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>

[[Lovolan]] created a subdued version of the [[R-10 household droid]] they had produced for use in the pleasure palaces of [[Hesperidium/Legends|Hesperidium]]. The unit was plated in tasteful black marble panels.<ref name="EGTD" />
